fees.tuitionAnnual.locator: Fee structure for B.Tech AY 2026-27 (PDF p.2, scanned, income above Rs 5 lakh) and Hostel Fee Structure 2026-27 Parts A and B. Mandatory = recurring 18,060/yr (library 2,420; computer 1,650; student activity 4,400; career 1,650; exam 3,300; medical 2,000; MIS 1,540; electricity 1,100) + one-time non-refundable 29,150 (admission 2,200, institute development 22,000, alumni 2,200, convocation 2,750)/4 = 7,287.50; sum 25,347.50 rounded to 25,348 to keep integer rupees (Rs 0.50/yr). Hostel = maintenance 6,000 + digital infrastructure 500 + mess advance 40,000 + hostel rent 5,800 + electricity & water 6,000; refundable cautions excluded; single hostel rate, no room types. Printed totals reconcile. Scanned figures; mess is an advance. Misc-fee Degree fee 2,500 not included
